court_node.scope: Core-contained steel is a finite alternative, not a selected post. Illustrative casing thickness is not a fire specification. SHS runs through the FIRST RC slab envelope and requires a real reinforced opening, seal and load transfer. Below-floor pad needs actual slab, thermal, mineral DPC and protected-route junction. Shank/sealing/baseplate, head, restraints, hollow-section access and cold node are unproved. Adjacent roof, wall and wind actions excluded.

jamb_crossing_trial.door_projection_scope: 300-square pad projects beneath the door opening and ends at z−80, 80 mm below FFL. Actual ground slab, finish, services and door-floor interface are unknown. The jamb replaces wall core; its head cage, door movement and adjoining rooms remain to check.
jamb_crossing_trial.scope: Finite layout sensitivity only. A 20 mm thick cap plate spans the head and outboard tie lines; head anchorage, welding/fastening, access, forces, upper wall continuation and slab clearance remain to design. Sleeve, capillary/air/gas barrier, four tie anchorage, bars/links, wall-head joint, uplift transfer, constructibility and physical tolerances remain unproved; 22 mm nominal sleeve separation is not a placement allowance.

heads.limitations: Source wall/floor budget represented as a uniform opening load solely for this separate comparison; no claim of actual distribution, concrete properties, member capacity, bearing, development, full cage, fire, head/door fit or combined permanent/favourable loads.

trial_cold_route.scope: Statically determinate line-route trial through four hypothetical jamb receivers; these are not established cold girders, actual piles, stiffness shares or ground reactions. Continuous cold reinforcement, local receiver and site must be developed.

trial_rebar.scope: Two bottom and two top illustrative Ø12 longitudinal bars in distinct transverse lanes; 180-degree ends in vertical planes. Hook length, actual reinforcement, cage interaction, anchorage and fit at all ends are not established.

hold_down_and_path: Four trial ties per jamb provide a bounded plan for an intended ridge/head/jamb/warm-pad/thermal-band/cold-rail path. Sleeve clearance is nominal and no actual connection, continuity, lateral resistance, bedding, seal or lower support is qualified.
limits: Head replacements change local masonry and require source-bound door crown/frame, protected-route fire, wall/slab/cage and service compatibility; no raw door arch is assumed to be a 2250 rectangle.

The selected-source court core corner is not an earned bearing; core SHS and hypothetical 15 mm casing have only geometric body-path screens, and post-to-first-floor, fire and protected-route acceptance are unresolved.
The 300-wide cloak jamb projects 53 mm each side; the 260-wide study jamb projects 33 mm. Body-path proxy, door leaf and circulation require explicit screening.
The west ridge carries an overhang beyond its support; adjacent roof region forces are omitted.

Saddle, bearing, mitres, baseplates and finite bracing are not sized or checked. A 60-square horizontal tie at +6500 crosses the bed2-L-return core and demands an actual framed wall opening; the pin-control force is not a whole-roof thrust or tie capacity.
Candidate lintel bars are geometry sketches, not reinforcement design, anchorage or construction release.

ridge_node.concept: Separate opposed mitred hip and valley meet at their crown; a shaped welded saddle within the 120-square node supports two orthogonal ridge members. The listed gap is a bounding dimension, not a continuous level bearing surface. Exact plate facets, weld access, local load transfer, uplift and horizontal thrust tie remain to resolve.
ridge_node.trial_tie_crossing_upper_wall: bed2-L-return at (2817.5,2817.5), inside core below trial +6550 wall top; a finite reinforced opening/replacement, air/fire seal and actual occupancy must be designed.
ridge_node.two_force_control_scope: Only the combined ridge-apex vertical point action, stipulated pinned two-force diagonal members and no other loads. Uplift reverses axial signs; real distributed roof actions, stiffness and all other lateral cases are excluded.

status: finite roof junction and door-head development geometry; no node, opening, structure or site pass
